permits.extent: College St 13 m West of Bay St to 17 m East of University Ave
permits.desc: The Overhead crew will work on the curblane on both eastbound and westbound on College St and Carlton St between McCaul and Parliament between July 26 and Dec 31, 2026. This will be a rolling operation. Scope of Work In support of TTC's ongoing system-wide overhead infrastructure modernization program, the following work is planned during the College Street streetcar service closure: * Installation of the auto-tensioning system. * Adjustment of the contact wire stagger to meet TTC Engineering's full pantograph standards. * Installation of new section breaks and removal of redundant section break infrastructure. * Testing and commissioning of the upgraded Track and OCS infrastructure before the restoration of regular streetcar service.
